key_insight: MethylVI is a deep probabilistic model that accurately represents single-cell bisulfite sequencing methylation profiles while explicitly modeling technical noise and biological variability, enabling robust imputation and downstream analysis of sparse methylome data.
problem_solved: Single-cell bisulfite sequencing yields extremely sparse, coverage-biased methylation measurements with batch and protocol effects; existing tools struggle to denoise, impute missing values, and provide calibrated uncertainty for downstream tasks.
method: Probabilistic deep generative model (variational autoencoder-style) that learns low-dimensional latent cell representations while modeling read coverage and site-specific technical biases.
Bayesian inference for posterior imputation of methylation probabilities and calibrated uncertainty estimates, enabling differential methylation testing and robust clustering/integration.
Design choices to handle extreme sparsity and batch effects: explicit coverage likelihood, hierarchical priors for site/cell effects, and scalable training for large single-cell datasets.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners a principled, scalable framework for representation learning and uncertainty-aware analyses of single-cell methylation data, improving tasks like cell-type discovery, imputation, and multi-omic integration.
visual_elements: Model schematic: encoder→latent space→decoder with branches illustrating coverage and methylation probability generation (annotate probabilistic components).
UMAP/tSNE of learned latent space colored by cell type or condition, showing separation and batch correction.
Heatmap or genome-browser style track comparing raw sparse methylation calls vs. MethylVI-imputed methylation probabilities across cells.
Bar/violin plots of uncertainty or posterior credible intervals for differentially methylated regions and precision/recall comparisons vs. baselines.
paper_title: Probabilistic modelling of single-cell bisulfite sequencing data with MethylVI
paper_authors: Ethan Weinberger, Wei Qiu, Wei Tian, Qiurui Zeng, Can Ergen
